set.body:
Design: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md section 8.0. StoryAtlas owns this consumer acceptance; StoryModel owns creation through its source preparation, stable recall inventory, public facade and canonical packet writer. External prerequisite: an exact reachable producer CLI/raw-input preparation/workspace-publication handoff with commands, schema versions, two-subject fixtures and receipts. Remain blocked until that evidence exists; no foreign-store dependency edge. Preserve prepared-bundle M1 as an earlier independent milestone.

Acceptance: begin with ordinary original-story text and two untimed subject recall files, and separately an admitted movie/source-annotation plus multi-recall case; execute the documented StoryModel producer workflow and open its unedited output with the same Atlas app.js. Inspect both subjects, every unit/outcome, nonwinning exact evidence, timing availability and replay/export. Demonstrate source reuse when adding a recall, participant/session identity refusal, wrong-edition refusal, per-subject failure preservation and interrupted/resumed output handling. The raw-video-only case must either run a supported configured film/perception route or report the exact missing capability; subject recalls cannot become source evidence. Actual compiled-film completion remains required by the existing movie gate.

Reuse the M1 Open, shared controller, inspector and film consumer; no second estimator or manual manifest/JSON editing. A UI wizard is optional convenience over the same public producer operation. Record exact producer/consumer revisions, setup steps, actual commands/results, fixture digests, independent expected IDs/values/support, relevant build/browser/permission courts and separate review. Keep old prepared-artifact opening usable if creation is unavailable. No runtime acceptance is claimed by filing this ticket.
set.title: [Setup] Open StoryModel-created studies from ordinary user inputs
